Flow Configuration ![CRM204_Flow Configuration](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CRM204_Flow%20Configuration.png){height="" width=""} ### Entry Criteria Defined on Account Object ![CRM204_Entry Criteria](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CRM204_Entry%20Criteria.jpg){height="" width=""} ### Get a Contact Record from the Account ![CRM204_Set Contact Record](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CRM204_Set%20Contact%20Record.png){height="" width=""} ### Looping the Process to Handle Contacts ![CRM204_Looping the Process](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CRM204_Looping%20the%20Process.png){height="" width=""} ### Define the Variables to get Data from the Contact Record ![CRM204_Define the Variables](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CRM204_Define%20the%20Variables.png){height="" width=""} ### Recipient Variable ![CRM204_Recipient Variable](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CRM204_Recipient%20Variable.png){height="" width=""} ### Collect Contact Records into a Collection Variable ![CRM204_Collect Contact Records](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CRM204_Collect%20Contact%20Records.png){height="" width=""} ### Call the Apex Method to Send SMS to the Valid Contact Records ![CRM204_Call the Apex Method](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CRM204_Call%20the%20Apex%20Method.png){height="" width=""}
